environment.description: Same Kubernetes pod deployed with a custom OCI runtime annotation specifying a fine-grained seccomp profile (deployed via RuntimeDefault override in CRI configuration at /etc/containerd/seccomp/redirect-processor.json). The profile operates in SCMP_ACT_ERRNO mode for the connect(2) syscall when the sockaddr_in destination matches 169.254.0.0/16 (link-local range) using a SCMP_CMP_MASKED_EQ comparator on the second argument. Additionally, the profile blocks raw socket creation (socket with SOCK_RAW type). The profile permits standard TCP connect to non-link-local addresses. Note: this is NOT a network policy — it's a BPF-backed seccomp filter compiled with libseccomp 2.5.4 that inspects syscall arguments at the kernel level before the network stack processes the connection.

config.filter_type: cBPF with argument inspection (SCMP_CMP_MASKED_EQ on arg1 sockaddr)
config.deployment_method: CRI-level RuntimeDefault override via containerd config annotation
